table.name: TLGNU_USER
table.description: User table. Contains all users which are recognized by Logon. Users are classified by type (Crh, Customer, Vendor) and can have several differnt access types: internal (LDAP, see ldap_holspace), external (user name/password) or PDA login (user number/PIN). For external and PDA access type this table contains a password/PIN management.

column.name: USER_ID
column.description: PK. This is also the 'uid' (used in the technical fields ctl_cre_uid, ctl_mod_uid) as well as the 'Principal' in the application. Unlike other applications, LOGON does not have a unique text login-name, but those depend on different access types.

column.name: PERSON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_person. The person data of this user. Person is mandatory for a user because of practical reasons: Logon does not have any common human readable 'loginname'; none of holspace, ext_login, pda_user_number is set for all users.

column.name: USER_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_user_type_bs. Type of User, e.g. Crh, Customer or Vendor. (Driver/PDA is not a user-type, but a login-type!)

column.name: SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The customer (business partner soldto) the user belongs to. For users not accociated to a customer, sap_bp_id is null.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_vendor. For the vendor for vendor/driver user types

column.name: LDAP_HOLSPACE
column.description: Login name for internal users, unique. This is the foreign key into the LDAP (Active Directory) of Crh and is null for users with only external or PDA access.

column.name: LDAP_ACTIVE_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: TODO - Field added for Later use - Logon 2.0 or so. Make required then!! Purpose: The date until when the account (LDAP login) is active. Crh security guidelines demand that user accounts are periodically checked and reactivated for the users which are still entitled to use Crh infrastructure.

column.name: EXT_LOGIN_ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: True, if user is allowed for external access. Internal/External login-type is independent of the User type (Crh, Customer, Vendor). TODO: This should be replaced by EXT_LOGIN_ACTIVE_UNTIL_DAT, and used for automatic account expiry. Crh guidelines demand account aging/refreshing. For the PDA login it's less important, but for the account this should be don.

column.name: EXT_LOGIN_ACTIVE_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: TODO - Field added for Later use - Logon 2.0 or so. Make required then!! Purpose: The date until when the account (ext login) is active. Crh security guidelines demand that user accounts are periodically checked and reactivated for the users which are still entitled to use Crh infrastructure.

column.name: EXT_LOGIN
column.description: External login name, unique. The system proposes an initial value based on user type and ID of BP/Vendor: <ldap_holspace> without the @..., c<cust_id>_xy, v<vendor_id>_xy, where xy is a combination of name/first name of the person, and cust_id/vendor_id the SAP_ID of the SAP_BP/SAP_VENDOR

column.name: EXT_LOGIN_PWD
column.description: External login password. A password set by the user via the application is stored encrypted. Plain text passwords are currently allowed (migration of user accounts from 1.0 DB, and to allow direct modifications in Tablebrowser for administrator). May be disabled in the future because of security concerns.

column.name: EXT_LOGIN_PWD_VALID_TO_DAT
column.description: The date till when the Password is valid. null = forever. After a password change, this date is set to sysdate + app.policy.PasswordLifeTime_d (see tlgnr_config).

column.name: EXT_LOGIN_PWD_LOCKED_TS
column.description: Date and Time in UTC+0 when the users external password was locked (null = unlocked). This state differs forom external login locked state (EXT_LOGIN_ACTIVE_FLAG = false) since when only the external password is locked then the user should be able to unlock her external password herself (the system sends an email whit the required steps to the address defined in tlgnc_person.email).

column.name: PDA_USER_NO
column.description: The PDA user number, unique. It is treated as a real number (only digits allowed), and 2 = 0002 etc. Crh normally use the employee number as PDA user number. The older numbers are 5 digits, the newer 7 digits long.

column.name: PDA_LOGIN_ACTIVE_UNTIL_DAT
column.description: TODO - Field added for later use - Logon 2.0 or so. Make required then!! Purpose: The date until when the account (PDA login) is active. Crh security guidelines demand that user accounts are periodically checked and reactivated for the users which are still entitled to use Crh infrastructure.

column.name: PDA_USER_RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_rfidobject. The RFID object of the User(link to the RFID tags)

column.name: PDA_PIN
column.description: The PIN for the PDA of the given user. Initially plaintext, turns into hash value if changed by user on PDA.

column.name: PDA_PIN_VALID_TO_DAT
column.description: The date till when the PIN is valid. null = forever. After a PIN change, this date is set to sysdate + app.policy.PINLifeTime_d (see tlgnr_config).

column.name: PICKUP_BARCODE_PASSCODE
column.description: Contains the additionally required information for the login pda_user_no + pickup_barcode_passcode in the case of bag/pickup terminal login. This is plain-text information; it is also written in human readable form on the user's badge.

column.name: PHOTO_IMAGE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_image. Image of the user. Purpose not really clear. Probably mainly meant for drivers (to print picture badges based on Logon data), but possible for other users as well.

column.name: SIGNATURE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_signature. Signature of this user, used on output documents such as Delivery Note. Not just drivers can have a signature, but also a sales person could have one, for example to sign order confirmations.

column.name: SIGNATURE_VALID_FLAG
column.description: Flag to say if signature is still ok to be used, or should/must be replaced with another one on next possible occasion.

column.name: APPLICATION_LANG_CD
column.description: Language used by the user in the application, or when the application contacts a user via PDA. Null (=get from browser preferences) is not supported because of this PDA use case.

column.name: SEND_DAILY_REPORTS_FLAG
column.description: When set to true, the user will receive daily reports by email (versandstatistik).

column.name: EXT_PWD_RESETTOKEN_HASH
column.description: Hash of the random token issued upon a password reset request for the user, or NULL if no token has ever been requested.

column.name: EXT_PWD_RESETTOKEN_VALID_TO_TS
column.description: The time after which the password reset token is no longer valid. If EXT_PWD_RESETTOKEN_HASH is not NULL then this must also be not NULL.

column.name: EXT_PWD_LAST_RESET_ATTEMPT_TS
column.description: The time of the most recent request of a reset token for the user, or NULL if no request has ever been made.

column.name: TIMEZONE_CD
column.description: Timezone assigned to this user entity
